name: One Spirit
source:
One Spirit is a coming-of-age visual novel set in an alternate timeline where the Cold War drags on into the 21st century. Exploring various political, cultural and philosophical themes, the game presents an engaging, thought-provoking thriller through the eyes of a group of marginal teenagers.

In 2003, the Iron Curtain stands tall. The superpowers of the new age wage a silent war through the means of information, economy, culture and proxy. As the Cold War slows to a crawl, the Sysican Republic, a post-socialist state in Eastern Europe, finds itself on the verge of political death as radicalism, conspiracy and war loom overhead.

One Spirit follows Yuri Danilin, an 18-year-old young man disenchanted with life, as he returns to his modest hometown in Nevilyovsk, Eastern Sysica. Having failed in his studies at the capital, he reunites with his sister knowing their time apart has changed both permanently. When news of a known local activist disappearing spread through the town, Yuri soon finds himself at the center of a downward spiral of violence.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1565810/One_Spirit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《One Spirit》是一部成长视觉小说，背景设定在另一个时间线上，冷战一直持续到21世纪。该游戏探索各种政治、文化和哲学主题，通过一群边缘青少年的视角呈现出一部引人入胜、发人深省的惊悚片。

2003年，铁幕高高耸立。新时代的超级大国通过信息、经济、文化和代理手段发动一场无声的战争。随着冷战的进展缓慢进行，西西卡共和国这个东欧的后社会主义国家发现自己正处于政治死亡的边缘，激进主义、阴谋和战争迫在眉睫。

《同一个灵魂》讲述了尤里·达尼林 (Yuri Danilin) 的故事，他是一位对生活不再抱有幻想的18岁年轻人，返回位于西西嘉东部涅维廖夫斯克的朴素家乡。在首都学业失败后，他与妹妹重聚，他知道他们分开的时间已经永远改变了两人。当一名当地知名活动人士失踪的消息传遍全镇时，尤里很快发现自己陷入了暴力恶性循环的中心。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1565810/One_Spirit/]Steam[/url]]
